dateline: El Paso, Texas — BTS Closes US Continental ARIRANG Tour Leg; Las Vegas (May 23–28) Next; 'SWIM' Five Weeks on Hot 100
heroHeadline: Day 4,707: BTS Completes Historic El Paso Debut Run — ARIRANG Tour Heads to Las Vegas as 'SWIM' Finishes Five Weeks on the Hot 100
heroSubtitle: May 3, 2026 is Day 4,707 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS has closed the US continental leg of the ARIRANG World Tour with two sold-out shows (May 2–3) at Sun Bowl Stadium in El Paso, Texas — the group's first-ever performances in El Paso and the US–Mexico border region. Night 1 (May 2) featured surprise songs 'ON' and 'OUTRO: WINGS [NEW],' a freshly arranged version of the 2016 track. Both nights drew estimated 100,000+ fans across two evenings, with cross-border attendance from Ciudad Juárez. The tour's next North American stop is a four-night Las Vegas residency at Allegiant Stadium (May 23, 24, 27, 28); Asia dates begin in June with Busan Asiad Main Stadium sold-out shows on June 12–13 (BTS's 13th debut anniversary). Separately, 'SWIM' completes five consecutive weeks on the Billboard Hot 100 (peaking No. 1 → ~No. 22 in week 5) — a sustained chart run unprecedented for K-pop in the post-streaming era. South Korean prosecutors have rejected a police arrest warrant request against HYBE Chairman Bang Si-hyuk (investor fraud allegation), with police weighing re-filing; no change to HYBE operations or the tour.
